summary: One of the fastest OAuth setups available. Registering a GitHub App or OAuth App is self-serve, takes minutes, and no approval or review is needed before real users can authorize your app.

approval.typical_timeline: Minutes. No approval or review needed to create the app or let users authorize it.
approval.notes: Listing on the GitHub Marketplace is optional and has its own separate review; you do not need it for OAuth.

steps.title: Decide between a GitHub App and an OAuth App
steps.detail: GitHub's own docs steer new integrations toward GitHub Apps (fine-grained permissions, installation model). OAuth Apps are the older, simpler option for sign-in-only use cases.

steps.title: Register the app in Developer settings
steps.detail: Profile picture -> Settings -> Developer settings -> GitHub Apps -> New GitHub App (or OAuth Apps -> New OAuth App). Choose a name unique across GitHub, set the Homepage URL, and add up to 10 callback URLs.

steps.title: Choose minimum permissions
steps.detail: For each permission pick Read-only, Read & write, or No access. GitHub recommends the minimum necessary.

steps.title: Create the app and generate credentials
steps.detail: After Create, collect the Client ID and generate a Client Secret. Keep user authorization tokens expiring (GitHub's recommended default).

steps.title: Implement the OAuth web flow or device flow
steps.detail: Send users to the authorize URL, exchange the returned code for a user access token. Device flow is available for headless/CLI apps.

nuances: An account can register at most 100 GitHub Apps; no limit on installations.
The app name must be unique across all of GitHub and cannot match an existing account name (unless it is your own).
No review gates any of this; the only gated surface is the optional Marketplace listing.
agent_can_do: Walk the registration form with you and explain every field
Generate the OAuth flow code for your stack
Map the permissions your integration actually needs
human_must_do: Click through the registration in your own GitHub account
Decide GitHub App vs OAuth App for your product model
